chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

key_terms.تُورِثُ: causes one to inherit; leads to
key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.ٱلتَّعْزِيَةُ: offering condolences and consoling someone in grief
key_terms.ٱلْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the eternal abode of reward

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for offering condolences in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of offering condolences to those afflicted by loss. It presents consoling the bereaved as a deed of great spiritual merit that leads to Paradise.
